acceptanceCriteria: Oversized ignore files are refused with a fixed read cap.
Symlinked and nonregular ignore-file inputs cannot block the command or escape the repository read boundary.
A skipped observation leaves the original command receipt and exit status intact and creates no ledger temporary.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, SEC-02. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: gap.

Every valid observation Append first reads root/.gitignore and potentially .corvint/.gitignore with os.ReadFile, before the directory/ledger safeguards. These reads have no byte cap, regular-file check, or context. Oversized or nonregular ignore input can therefore consume unbounded resources or block an append; recordUnsupported invokes Append synchronously after a refusal. Availability impact is inferred from the source and was not demonstrated. This also leaves the ignore decision dependent on bytes reached through symlinks.

Source: internal/observations/observations.go:250; internal/observations/observations.go:710; cmd/corvint/main.go:1385

Owning contract/status: ["SOL-V0-001", "SOL-V0-003", "SOL-V0-007"]

Verification: {"method": "Source inspection", "test": "Existing TestAppendRepairReadIsBounded covers ledger tail reads, and TestAppendRefusesSymlinkedLedgerDirectoryOrFile covers ledger/store paths; neither covers ignore-file ingestion. These observation tests were inspected, not run.", "reproduction": "NOT_RUN: no oversized/special-file inputs or payloads executed."}

Suggested correction: Read ignore policy through a bounded regular-file-only helper that refuses symlinks and nonregular files before blocking ingestion; conservatively skip the optional observation when policy cannot be read safely.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.
